The '''''Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide''''' was the official military guidebook for strategies, branches, units, philosophy, and history for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|military forces]]. The handbook contained information on the Imperial military, navy, stormtrooper corps, and the Imperial doctrine. It was considered vital for various Imperial commanders of the various branches of the Imperial Military, although [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] himself acknowledged in his concluding note that even the book was the smallest part of a commander's lesson. Although it was intended solely for use among the Imperial forces, [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] had managed to locate a copy six months after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], and supplied it to the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance Command]], where they proceeded to supply notes for the various elements in the book. As a result, one of the members of high command, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]], managed to come up with a strategy to remove Imperial influence in the [[Vorzyd sector/Legends|Vorzyd sector]] by sabotaging [[Deepdock/Legends|deepdocks]] in the sector due to information from the book.
